note: Rewritten from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the source describes soldiers and workers and records alates as unknown. Two figures, the mandible length and the maximum postmental width of the soldier, are omitted because of OCR damage (t.13-I.I5, 0,301). Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been deleted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, slightly darker posteriorly; antennae and labrum pale yellow; mandibles reddish brown, pale yellow at the base. Head sparsely pilose, body more densely pilose. Total body length 4.50 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, slightly narrowed anteriorly; sides slightly convex; length to mandibular base 1.175 mm, maximum width 0.85 mm, width/length ratio 0.72. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus not clearly delimited from the frons. Labrum pentagonal, wider than long (length 0.20 mm, width 0.28 mm). Mandibles long and slender, sword-shaped, apical part strongly incurved; finely serrate, without large teeth; slightly shorter than the head (left mandible length/head length ratio 0.98). Postmentum short and stout, waist weakly constricted (length 0.55 mm, waist width 0.25 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a distinct notch, posterior margin nearly straight (length 0.30 mm, width 0.58 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow; antennae paler; body yellowish white. Head and body rather densely pilose. Total body length 3.3–3.7 mm. Head capsule subquadrate; length to mandibular base 0.78–0.88 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.88 mm. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus convex, length about half its width; anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly notched, posterior margin nearly straight; length 0.28–0.30 mm, width 0.55 mm.
